Thank you for your interest in contributing to Gerrit MCP Server!

This project uses Gerrit for code changes and review:

- The canonical repository is
  [gerrit.googlesource.com/gerrit-mcp-server](https://gerrit.googlesource.com/gerrit-mcp-server).
- GitHub pull requests are not accepted and cannot be merged.
- Please follow the [contribution guidelines](../docs/contributing.md) to submit
  a change through Gerrit.

For bugs and feature requests, please use the
[Gerrit MCP Server component](https://issues.gerritcodereview.com/components/1895778)
in the [Gerrit issue tracker](https://issues.gerritcodereview.com/).

Due to spam abuse, membership in the
[repo-discuss Google Group](https://groups.google.com/group/repo-discuss) is
required to create issues. See the
[announcement](https://www.gerritcodereview.com/2025-06-05-community-managers-minutes.html#reducing-spam-on-both-issue-tracker-and-gerritgooglesource)
for more information.
